haiku-low.q1: Held 10 minutes (expires_at = created + 10 min). If not confirmed in time, Inventory's sweeper, running every minute, releases it and stock goes back on sale.
haiku-low.q2: Before. Inventory reserves all lines first. If any line is short, nothing is reserved, status becomes REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK, short items are shown, no payment is requested, and the cart is untouched.
haiku-low.q3: The retry reuses the same idempotency key (order id), so the provider returns the original charge instead of making a new one.
haiku-low.q4: Order gets one fresh all-or-nothing reservation. If that fails, status becomes REFUNDING, Payment refunds the full amount, then the order becomes CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK and the customer is emailed. Cart untouched.
haiku-low.q5: Only when Cart receives OrderConfirmed, Cart deletes it. Every failure path leaves the cart as it was.
haiku-low.q6: The Order service moves each checkout between steps. Its record is the order's status in the Order service's own database.
haiku-low.q7: The provider sends a webhook to Payment, which records the outcome and publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentFailed on the message broker for Order to act on.
haiku-low.q8: Payment drops webhooks whose provider payment id is already recorded. Order acts on payment events only while AWAITING_PAYMENT, so repeats find the order moved on and are ignored.
haiku-low.q9: Order asks Inventory to release the reservation immediately on PaymentFailed, and status becomes PAYMENT_FAILED. It does not wait for the sweeper.
haiku-low.q10: Order asks Inventory to confirm the reservation. If still active, it commits. If expired, Order tries one fresh all-or-nothing reservation: all in stock means fulfil, otherwise refund.
haiku-low.q11: The refund row is set PENDING and retried every 5 minutes, up to 12 tries. After the 12th failure it is marked MANUAL, support is alerted, and the order stays REFUNDING. Tracked in Payment's refund row.
haiku-low.q12: Cart service deletes the cart when it receives OrderConfirmed. No other service deletes carts.

sonnet.q1: Held for 10 minutes (expires_at = created + 10 min). If not confirmed within 10 min, Inventory's sweeper (runs every minute) releases the reservation and stock goes back on sale.
sonnet.q2: Stock is reserved before charging. If any line is short, Inventory reserves nothing; the order becomes REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK, the customer is shown the short items, no payment is requested and the cart is untouched.
sonnet.q3: The retry uses the same idempotency key (the order id), so the provider returns the original charge instead of making a new one.
sonnet.q4: Order makes one fresh all-or-nothing reservation attempt; if it fails, status becomes REFUNDING, the full amount is refunded, then the order becomes CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK and the customer is emailed (refunded, item sold out).
sonnet.q5: The cart is deleted only after the order is CONFIRMED (Cart receives OrderConfirmed). On every failure path the cart is left as it was.
sonnet.q6: The Order service orchestrates the steps; the record of progress is the order's status in the Order service's DB.
sonnet.q7: Provider sends a webhook to Payment; Payment records the outcome and publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentFailed as a broker event, which the Order service consumes.
sonnet.q8: Payment drops webhooks whose provider payment id is already recorded. For repeated broker events, Order acts only while the order is AWAITING_PAYMENT, so a repeat finds it already moved on and is ignored.
sonnet.q9: Order asks Inventory to release the reservation immediately, status becomes PAYMENT_FAILED, cart untouched. The trigger is the PaymentFailed event.
sonnet.q10: Order asks Inventory to confirm the reservation; if expired, it makes one fresh all-or-nothing reservation of the same lines. If all in stock, stock is committed and the order is CONFIRMED; if not, the order is refunded in full (REFUNDING then CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK). Never partial fulfilment.
sonnet.q11: Payment sets the refund row to PENDING and retries every 5 minutes, up to 12 tries (about 1 hour). After the 12th failure the refund is marked MANUAL and support on-call is alerted; the order stays REFUNDING. Tracking is in Payment's refund row (status, attempt count).
sonnet.q12: The Cart service deletes the cart when it receives the OrderConfirmed event, which Order publishes on confirmation.
